description.p: Aureus is a GTK4 and libadwaita portfolio tracker with activity-based holdings, account cash, dividends, portfolio history, stock search, a watchlist, reports, backups, and an adaptive interface.

Polishes Aureus dialogs and adaptive layouts, standardizes bottom action forms, fixes narrow-window scaling on Overview and stock pages, and remembers the selected Overview chart range between launches.

Adds exchange-aware pre-market and after-hours pricing with eligible extended-hours data on 1D stock charts, improves Yahoo Finance accuracy and resilience across quote and history ranges, and keeps chart colors aligned with canonical returns. Adds upcoming forward and reverse stock splits, automatic split-aware share accounting, restored-portfolio corporate-action reconciliation, payment-date dividend cash credits with a per-account opt-out, and further Allocation interaction and rendering refinements.

Refines pull-to-refresh and Allocation rendering, redesigns Dividends with a current-year Annual view and ownership-aware history, removes the detached dollar-stem artifact from the dividend headline, gives populated Recent Distributions a reliable Adwaita boxed-list surface, aligns Edit Account with Aureus's shared bottom-pill form actions, allows accounts with holdings or activity to be removed after an explicit destructive-data warning, uses gain/loss colors for Watchlist sparklines, and refines Allocation with a lighter ring, a cleaner breakdown, exact 100.0% displayed rounding, synchronized row/slice hover and selection, keyboard-accessible allocation rows, and an empty center until a stock is focused. Upcoming cards are now keyboard focusable. Updates the About tagline to “A clean portfolio tracker that just works”.
Fixes same-day 1D portfolio return calculations and adds Bank of Canada attribution for exchange-rate data.
Initial Aureus 1.0 release with portfolio tracking, account cash and transfers, dividends, interactive history charts, reporting, backups, and adaptive GTK4/libadwaita navigation.
